item.title: Eastern Michigan U. radio pulls interview with rabbi on campus antisemitism
item.description: Eastern Michigan University's WEMU radio station removed an interview with Rabbi Yitz Pierce regarding campus antisemitism after a listener complained about its perceived pro-Israel bias.

item.title: CU Boulder suspends student journalist for covering protest without permission
item.description: Free speech concerns are being raised about a student journalist at CU-Boulder who is under sanction after covering a protest.

item.title: U.S. under Trump mirrors dystopian ‘It’s a Wonderful Life’ town, professor says
item.description: The current political landscape reflects the dystopian “Pottersville” in the Christmas movie “It’s a Wonderful Life,” a professor wrote in a recent op-ed. University of North Texas Literary Professor Nora Gilbert compared the tyrannical setting of the movie to President Donald Trump’s policies on immigration, as well as what she views as growing greed, corruption, […]

item.title: OU removes trans instructor who gave Christian student’s Bible-based essay a zero
item.description: 'The graduate teaching assistant will no longer have instructional duties at the university.'

item.title: We spoke with the Turning Point leader forced off campus after death threats
item.description: OPINION/ANALYSIS College Fix Editor Gabrielle Temaat interviewed TPUSA chapter president Jacob York, a sophomore at Olivet Nazarene University. He reported receiving anonymous death threats via Instagram and is finishing his semester at home. Jacob told us what the threats said, how his university responded, and why he’s not backing down.

item.title: Professor: ‘It’s a Wonderful Life’ has ‘bigoted’ ideas
item.description: Many people love the movie 'It's a Wonderful Life.' They need to ponder its racist message, one professor says.

item.title: 10 stories that made us smile in 2025
item.description: Enjoy a walk down memory lane as we highlight some of those stories that made us smile this year.

item.title: Lawsuit challenges U. Rhode Island’s ‘preference’ for hiring union members
item.description: A lawsuit filed by Nicole Solas accuses the University of Rhode Island of discrimination against non-union members in its hiring practices.

item.title: Move over Christmas tree: Some campuses opt for term ‘holiday tree’ instead
item.description: From New York to Alaska, some universities chose to use the neutral holiday tree term rather than Christmas tree, a practice that illustrates a broader secularization trend surrounding the holiday season.
